decisions.reason: The cleaning soap completes the firm's established floor-care range at little ongoing cost, and two years on the market are still short enough to treat any weak sales as a ramp-up effect.
The multi-model maintenance oil line represents visible investment and is central to the firm's announced surface-treatment and maintenance offer, so management will persist with it.
The care line for oiled floors is tied directly to the firm's oiled-parquet business, and the sunk costs in its several models strongly favour keeping it.

Withdrawing the foam underlay already concentrated the accessory offer on this moisture-protection underlay, which management will defend as the justified choice and keep as a natural system accessory.
The oak parquet line sits at the core of the firm's production investment and brand, which makes dropping it very unlikely.
